reader.requirement: At 85 each of the INPUT, OUTPUT, I-O and EXTEND phrases may appear in at most one USE statement of the declaratives of a given Procedure Division (whichever of ERROR or EXCEPTION is written), a second one being refused, while a contained program's own Procedure Division may repeat a phrase its container uses.

edition-consulted.switches: the 1985 required words AFTER and PROCEDURE; the SR6 duplicate check itself has no edition test

reader.edition-search: DeclBindUse's mode arm (_useModes.Register, ConstructOperand.Duplicate, COBOL0897) has no Edition/DialectLevel test; EXTEND is a level-2 boxed phrase the 1985 format admits and the grammar accepts at every edition
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: p4dupmix is refused with COBOL0897 at 85 and at 2023
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf28_02 shows the four phrases each once (the acceptance half); the refusal half and the per-Procedure-Division scope in a nested program are probe-only

citations.check: OK  §1985:VIII.4.8.3 SR6  (4.8.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR6

reader.notes: DeclBindUse registers each mode operand in a per-Procedure-Division registry and reports COBOL0897 on a duplicate; ERROR and EXCEPTION share it. The diagnostic cites the 2023 rule number (SR7), a message-text matter only.

refuter.evidence: Beyond the reader's same-form duplicates: r5glob2-001 puts USE GLOBAL AFTER STANDARD ERROR ON INPUT and USE AFTER STANDARD EXCEPTION ON INPUT in one Procedure Division: refused COBOL0897 'this open mode already has a USE procedure in this procedure division' (the GLOBAL phrase of §1985:X.5.5.2 does not create a second scope). r5nestg-001: the container's GLOBAL INPUT USE and a contained program's own INPUT USE compile and the inner one wins (INNER-INPUT STI=35), so the scope is per Procedure Division. Grep of ProcedureTableBuilder.cs for Edition/DialectLevel shows only ctx.Edition.At/Error reporting. Diagnostic cites §2023:14.9.49.3 SR7 at 85 (message text only). cite.py: OK §1985:VIII.4.8.3 SR6.
